author: The_Illuminati_
body:
Hi. My name is The_Illuminati_ on the avicus server. I absolutely love this server, but, yesterday, after playing nebula, I was banned for anti-knockback hacks. I have no idea why, other than maybe some lag. If someone could look into this, I would be very grateful, and I will do anything that you can ask me to prove that I am innocent. Thanks so much!

The_Illuminati_

title: Anti-knockback ban

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
The_Illuminati_,

In light of the evidence shown, your ban has been reconsidered. I have appealed and deleted the infraction due to the mistake we made. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Regards,
Straightened
Avicus Network Administrator
